items.title: Efficacy of exoskeleton rehabilitation robots for upper limb function recovery in stroke patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review of 28 trials (N=1,407) found that exoskeleton-assisted training improved FMA-UE (MD 5.30, 95% CI 3.82–6.79), WMFT (MD 4.78, 95% CI 1.99–7.58), and ARAT (MD 2.70, 95% CI 0.81–4.58) scores in stroke patients compared to conventional rehabilitation; effects on daily living activities were inconsistent.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后上肢功能障碍患者，外骨骼辅助训练确实比传统康复更有效，尤其是在 FMA-UE 等核心运动功能评估上。但 ADL 改善的证据仍不一致，且该领域异质性高、最佳训练剂量不明，临床应用时要考虑这些限制。
items.titleZh: 外骨骼康复机器人在卒中患者上肢功能恢复中的疗效：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 28 项试验（N=1,407）的系统综述发现，与传统康复相比，外骨骼辅助训练能改善卒中患者的 Fugl-Meyer 上肢评估（MD 5.30, 95% CI 3.82–6.79）、Wolf 运动功能测试（MD 4.78, 95% CI 1.99–7.58）和 Action Research Arm Test（MD 2.70, 95% CI 0.81–4.58）评分，但对日常生活活动能力的影响尚不一致。
items.curatedReasonEn: For stroke patients with upper limb motor impairment, exoskeleton-assisted training is more effective than conventional rehabilitation, especially on core motor function assessments like FMA-UE. However, evidence for ADL improvement remains inconsistent, and high heterogeneity and unknown optimal training dose warrant cautious clinical application.
items.limitation: 研究存在显著异质性（FMA-UE 的 I²=90%，FIM 的 I²=97%），部分结局对单个研究敏感，且存在潜在研究层面混杂。
items.limitationEn: There was substantial heterogeneity (I²=90% for FMA-UE, I²=97% for FIM), some outcomes were sensitive to individual trials, and potential study-level confounding exists.

items.title: Relationship between physical activity and stem cell production: A systematic review
items.summary: A systematic review of 19 articles found that increased physical activity, including both aerobic and anaerobic, endurance and resistance exercise, was associated with enhanced stem cell production and mobilization across children, adults, and the elderly, independent of stem cell type.
items.curatedReason: 这份系统综述坐实了运动疗法对不同年龄段人群（包括老年人）干预的生物学基础：规律的耐力或阻抗训练能有效促进干细胞生成与动员，支持组织修复。你在给老年患者制定运动处方时，可以更有信心去强调其对细胞层面健康的益处。
items.titleZh: 体力活动与干细胞生成的关系：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 19 篇文章的系统综述发现，增加体力活动，包括有氧和无氧、耐力和阻抗运动，都与儿童、成人和老年人干细胞生成和动员的增强相关，且与干细胞类型无关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review confirms the biological basis of exercise therapy across different age groups, including older adults: regular endurance or resistance training effectively promotes stem cell production and mobilization, supporting tissue repair. You can confidently emphasize these cellular-level health benefits when prescribing exercise for older patients.
items.limitation: 虽然评估了偏倚风险和证据质量，但研究异质性可能仍存在，且具体生理机制有待进一步阐明。
items.limitationEn: Although bias risk and evidence quality were assessed, heterogeneity might still exist, and specific physiological mechanisms need further elucidation.

items.title: Isometric muscle strength and inter-limb differences in relation to countermovement jump performance during the return-to-sport phase after ACL reconstruction: a cross-sectional study
items.summary: In 14 post-ACLR patients (mean 8.6 months post-op), isometric knee extension strength (1.00 vs. 1.24 kg/kg, p=0.001) and flexion strength (0.57 vs. 0.67 kg/kg, p=0.015) were significantly lower in the operated limb, which was a primary determinant of limb-specific CMJ kinetic output.
items.curatedReason: 前交叉韧带重建术后（ACLR）返场运动（RTS）阶段，单侧等长肌力测试与双侧反向跳（CMJ）的联合评估很有价值。操作侧肢体的等长肌力是决定 CMJ 动力学输出的关键，在 RTS 评估中应予重点关注。
items.titleZh: ACL 重建术后返场运动阶段等长肌力与肢体间差异对反向跳表现的影响：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 在 14 名 ACL 重建术后（平均 8.6 个月）患者中，手术侧膝关节伸肌（1.00 vs. 1.24 kg/kg, p=0.001）和屈肌（0.57 vs. 0.67 kg/kg, p=0.015）等长肌力显著较低，且是肢体特异性反向跳动力学输出的主要决定因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: Combined assessment of unilateral isometric strength and bilateral countermovement jump (CMJ) is valuable during the return-to-sport (RTS) phase after ACL reconstruction (ACLR). Operated limb isometric strength is a primary determinant of limb-specific CMJ kinetic output and should be a focus in RTS assessment.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（14 名患者），且为横断面设计，无法建立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (14 patients) and is a cross-sectional design, preventing causal inference.

items.title: Does whole-body electromyostimulation improve functional, compositional, and biochemical outcomes in older women with sarcopenia? A randomized controlled trial
items.summary: In an 8-week RCT (N=30), sarcopenic older women receiving whole-body electromyostimulation (WB-EMS) showed significant improvements in balance, handgrip strength, functional capacity, body composition (reduced weight, BMI, fat; increased skeletal muscle mass), and myokine profiles compared to controls.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 提示，对于老年肌少症女性，全身电肌肉刺激（WB-EMS）能够改善功能、体成分和肌细胞因子。你可以考虑将 WB-EMS 作为不适合传统阻抗训练患者的补充手段，但需注意该研究样本小且未盲法。
items.titleZh: 全身电肌肉刺激能否改善老年肌少症女性的功能、体成分和生化指标？一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 8 周的随机对照试验（N=30）显示，与对照组相比，接受全身电肌肉刺激（WB-EMS）的老年肌少症女性在平衡、握力、功能能力、体成分（体重、BMI、脂肪减少；骨骼肌质量增加）和肌细胞因子谱方面均有显著改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that whole-body electromyostimulation (WB-EMS) can improve function, body composition, and myokine profiles in sarcopenic older women. You may consider WB-EMS as a supplementary option for patients unable to perform conventional resistance training, noting the small sample size and lack of blinding in this study.
items.limitation: 本研究为开放标签的随机试验，无分配隐藏和盲法结局评估，样本量较小（30 人）。
items.limitationEn: This was an open-label randomized trial without allocation concealment or blinded outcome assessment, with a small sample size (30 participants).

items.title: Education and training pathways for advanced musculoskeletal physiotherapists: a qualitative study investigating competency.
items.summary: A qualitative study in Tasmania, Australia, found that Advanced Musculoskeletal Practitioners' (AMPs) education and training are heavily reliant on workplace-based learning, with identified gaps in health-service collaboration and integration of external advanced practice training.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚的定性研究揭示，先进肌肉骨骼物理治疗师（AMPs）的教育和培训仍以工作场所为基础，缺乏系统性的健康服务协作与外部高级实践培训整合。你需要推动政策和监管层面的协调，才能真正提升 AMPs 的能力与服务质量。
items.titleZh: 先进肌肉骨骼物理治疗师教育培训路径：一项探讨能力素养的定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项澳大利亚塔斯马尼亚州的定性研究发现，先进肌肉骨骼物理治疗师（AMPs）的教育和培训主要依赖工作场所学习，但在健康服务协作和外部高级实践培训整合方面存在不足。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Australian qualitative study reveals that Advanced Musculoskeletal Physiotherapists' (AMPs) education and training are predominantly workplace-based, lacking systemic health service collaboration and integration with external advanced practice training. You need to advocate for policy and regulatory alignment to truly enhance AMPs' competence and service quality.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，仅限于塔斯马尼亚的AMPs，外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study limited to AMPs in Tasmania, thus generalizability is limited.

items.title: Augmenting Conventional Rehabilitation with Virtual Reality or Aerobic Exercise in Multiple Sclerosis: A Three-Arm Parallel-Group Superiority Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A three-arm superiority RCT (n=30) found that adding Virtual Reality (VR) or Aerobic Exercise (AE) to conventional rehabilitation for Multiple Sclerosis (MS) patients did not show statistical superiority over conventional therapy alone, but all groups demonstrated significant within-group improvements in perceived manual ability, fatigue, and cognitive functions (p < 0.05). VR showed moderate-to-large effect sizes (η²p from 0.15 to 0.63) in exploratory observations.
items.curatedReason: 本项 RCT 证实，对于多发性硬化症（MS）患者，在常规康复中增加虚拟现实（VR）或有氧运动（AE）在改善功能、减轻疲劳和认知方面与常规康复本身效果等同。这为 MS 康复提供了更多可行的辅助疗法选择。
items.titleZh: 多发性硬化症患者常规康复中加入虚拟现实或有氧运动：一项三臂平行优效性随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项三臂优效性随机对照试验（n=30）发现，在多发性硬化症（MS）患者的常规康复中加入虚拟现实（VR）或有氧运动（AE），在统计学上并未显示出优于单独常规疗法，但所有组在感知手动能力、疲劳和认知功能上均显示出显著组内改善（p < 0.05）。探索性观察中，VR 在非优势手敏捷性和手动速度参数上显示出中到大效应量（η²p 范围 0.15 至 0.63）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT confirms that adding Virtual Reality (VR) or Aerobic Exercise (AE) to conventional rehabilitation for Multiple Sclerosis (MS) patients is equally effective in improving functional performance, reducing fatigue, and enhancing cognition as conventional rehabilitation alone. This provides more viable adjunctive therapy options for MS rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，可能限制了检测出 VR 或 AE 统计学优越性的能力。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size, which may have limited the ability to detect statistical superiority for VR or AE.

items.title: [Correspondence] Urgent Medicaid exceptions for refugees in the USA
items.summary: US Public Law 119-21, effective October 1, 2026, removes refugee status as an independent basis for Medicaid coverage, threatening to interrupt essential medical treatment and rehabilitation for refugees with disabilities and chronic illnesses.
items.curatedReason: 自 2026 年 1 日起，美国实施的公共法案 119-21 取消了难民身份作为 Medicaid 覆盖的独立依据，这直接影响了美国境内难民患者的康复服务可及性。你应留意患者的医保状态，及时调整转诊和治疗方案，避免服务中断。
items.titleZh: 美国紧急 Medicaid 豁免对难民的影响
items.summaryZh: 美国公共法案 119-21 已于 2026 年 1 日生效，取消了难民身份作为 Medicaid 覆盖的独立依据，这可能导致残疾和慢性病难民的必要医疗和康复治疗中断。
items.curatedReasonEn: Effective October 1, 2026, US Public Law 119-21 removes refugee status as an independent basis for Medicaid coverage, directly impacting access to rehabilitation services for refugee patients in the US. You should be aware of patients' insurance status and adjust referral and treatment plans promptly to avoid service disruptions.

items.title: Current Clinical Practice and Barriers to Instrumented Gait Assessment in Stroke Rehabilitation: A Cross-Sectional Survey.
items.summary: A cross-sectional survey (n=329) among Japanese physiotherapists found that 91.2% recognized the need for instrumented gait assessment in stroke rehabilitation, but only 39.8% used it routinely. Key barriers included equipment unavailability (80.2% of non-users), excessive measurement time (associated with time burden for ≥20 min, OR 3.59, 95% CI 1.04-12.46), high costs, and difficulty interpreting results.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对日本物理治疗师的调查揭示，尽管多数人认为器械步态评估有必要，但常规使用率低。改善设备可及性、开发省时且便携的自动化分析系统，是推动其在卒中康复中普及的关键。
items.titleZh: 卒中康复中器械步态评估的当前临床实践与障碍：一项横断面调查
items.summaryZh: 一项针对日本物理治疗师的横断面调查（n=329）发现，91.2% 的受访者认识到在卒中康复中进行器械步态评估的必要性，但仅有 39.8% 的人常规使用。主要障碍包括设备不可用（80.2% 的非使用者）、测量时间过长（与测量时间≥20分钟相关，OR 3.59，95% CI 1.04-12.46）、设备成本高以及结果解释困难。
items.curatedReasonEn: This survey of Japanese physical therapists reveals that while most recognize the need for instrumented gait assessment, its routine use is low. Improving equipment access and developing time-efficient, portable systems with automated analysis are key to promoting its integration into stroke rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面调查，存在回忆偏倚，且仅限于日本物理治疗师，结果的普适性受限。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional survey is subject to recall bias and is limited to Japanese physical therapists, restricting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Video-based assessment of functional movement quality in female adults with surgical and non-surgical scoliosis and controls: a rater-blinded observational study.
items.summary: An observational study with 30 female adults found that long spinal fusion for scoliosis may have minimal measurable effect on some movement tasks, but could be associated with greater deviation scores in others, with task-specific deficits potentially appearing at later follow-up (exploratory n=4 at 2 years).
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究提示，长节段脊柱融合术对某些运动任务的影响可能要到术后更长时间才会显现。在与患者讨论手术利弊时，这能帮你从功能角度更好地权衡。
items.titleZh: 女性成人脊柱侧凸患者（手术及非手术）与对照组功能性运动质量的视频评估：一项评估者盲法观察性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对30名女性成人进行的观察性研究发现，脊柱侧凸长节段融合术对部分运动任务的影响可能不明显，但在其他任务中可能导致更大的偏离分数，且特定任务的功能缺陷可能在后期随访（2年时探索性n=4）才显现。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that the impact of long spinal fusion on some movement tasks may only become apparent at later follow-ups. This helps you to better weigh functional trade-offs when discussing surgical pros and cons with patients.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（n=30），且术后2年随访仅包含探索性n=4的数据，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (n=30), and the 2-year post-surgical follow-up included an exploratory n=4, limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Gait variability as a predictor of fall risk in patients with stroke: A 6-month prospective cohort study with survival analysis.
items.summary: In 112 stroke patients, a 6-month prospective cohort study found stride time variability (STV) at discharge was an independent predictor of post-discharge falls, with an optimal cutoff of 3.40% (AUC 0.756, 95% CI 0.657-0.851).
items.curatedReason: 对于卒中患者，出院时步态时间变异性（STV）是预测 6 个月内跌倒风险的独立指标。你可以将 3.40% 的 STV 阈值纳入常规评估，以早期识别高风险患者并进行针对性跌倒预防干预。
items.titleZh: 步态变异性作为卒中患者跌倒风险预测指标：一项为期 6 个月的前瞻性生存分析队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 112 名卒中患者进行的为期 6 个月前瞻性队列研究发现，出院时的步态时间变异性（STV）是出院后跌倒的独立预测因素，最佳临界值为 3.40%（AUC 0.756，95% CI 0.657-0.851）。
items.curatedReasonEn: For stroke patients, stride time variability (STV) at discharge is an independent predictor of falls within 6 months. You can integrate the 3.40% STV cutoff into your routine assessments for early identification of high-risk patients and targeted fall-prevention interventions.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心前瞻性队列研究，且仅限于住院卒中患者，结果外推需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center prospective cohort study limited to hospitalized stroke patients, so generalizability requires caution.

items.title: The new body-as-machine: a response to Breedt, Tichenor, and Barlott's "Diagnosing the body in physiotherapy".
items.summary: This response paper critically reflects on a recent article tracing physiotherapy's evolving concept of the body from mechanical to modulated, highlighting tensions in its treatment of Foucauldian biopower and neoliberalism.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评反思了物理治疗中“身体即机器”的思维模式如何演变。它促使你重新审视实践中对生物心理社会模型的宣称，以及疼痛科学中日益增长的控制论思维。
items.titleZh: 新的“身体即机器”观：回应 Breedt, Tichenor 和 Barlott 的《物理治疗中的身体诊断》
items.summaryZh: 这篇回应文章批判性地反思了 Breedt, Tichenor 和 Barlott 最近一篇文章，该文追溯了物理治疗中身体概念从机械到调制的演变，并强调了其在福柯式生命权力与新自由主义处理方式中的张力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary critically examines the evolving "body-as-machine" paradigm in physiotherapy. It prompts you to re-evaluate claims of biopsychosocialism in practice and the growing cybernetic thinking in pain science.

items.title: Effectiveness of different exercise types for improving lumbar spine and femoral neck bone mineral density in older adults: a three-level pairwise and Bayesian network meta-analysis
items.summary: A Bayesian network meta-analysis of 81 RCTs (5,251 participants) found exercise significantly improved lumbar spine BMD (MD = 0.013 g/cm²) and femoral neck BMD (MD = 0.018 g/cm²) in older adults, with Traditional Chinese Exercise showing the most favorable estimates, but with low certainty.
items.curatedReason: 对老年患者，运动处方仍是提升腰椎和股骨颈骨密度的基石，这篇高质量的系统综述再次确认了这一点。尽管传统中医运动在数据上表现最好，但证据等级不高，我们不应仅推荐某一种特定运动。记住，运动方案要个体化，并全面考虑患者的共病情况。
items.titleZh: 不同运动类型对改善老年人腰椎和股骨颈骨密度的有效性：三级配对和贝叶斯网络 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对 81 项 RCT（5,251 名参与者）进行的贝叶斯网络 Meta 分析发现，运动显著改善了老年人的腰椎骨密度（平均差 = 0.013 g/cm²）和股骨颈骨密度（平均差 = 0.018 g/cm²），其中中式传统运动显示出最有利的估计，但证据确定性较低。
items.curatedReasonEn: For older patients, exercise remains the cornerstone for improving lumbar spine and femoral neck BMD; this high-quality systematic review confirms it. While Traditional Chinese Exercise showed the most favorable estimates, the certainty of evidence is low, so we shouldn't exclusively recommend one specific type. Remember to individualize exercise prescriptions and comprehensively consider patient comorbidities.
items.limitation: 证据确定性在腰椎为中等，在股骨颈为低，且网络 Meta 分析结果（尤其是中式传统运动排名最优）确定性为低到极低，提示需谨慎解释。
items.limitationEn: Evidence certainty was moderate for the lumbar spine and low for the femoral neck, with network meta-analysis results (especially the top ranking of Traditional Chinese Exercise) having low-to-very-low certainty, warranting cautious interpretation.

items.title: Force and Power Testing in Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction Literature: A Scoping Review
items.summary: A scoping review of 1625 studies on post-ACLR force and power testing found significant heterogeneity in device selection, metrics, and protocols, with isokinetic dynamometry being the most adopted but current practices more varied.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述揭示了 ACLR 术后力量和功率测试方法的高度异质性，强调你在选择评估工具和解释结果时需要注意标准化，并可考虑联合使用多种评估设备。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带重建文献中的力量和功率测试：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 1625 项关于 ACLR 术后力量和功率测试的研究的范围综述发现，设备选择、指标和方案存在显著异质性，等速肌力测试仪仍是使用最广泛的设备，但当前实践更加多样化。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review reveals significant heterogeneity in force and power testing methods post-ACLR, highlighting the need for standardization when selecting assessment tools and interpreting results, and suggesting consideration of combining multiple assessment devices.
items.limitation: 作为范围综述，它侧重于现有文献的广度而非深度，不评估证据质量，也无法提供具体的临床实践建议。
items.limitationEn: As a scoping review, it prioritizes the breadth of existing literature over depth, does not assess evidence quality, and cannot provide specific clinical practice recommendations.

items.title: Unpacking what works in home rehabilitation in relation to contexts, mechanisms, and outcomes in a qualitative scoping review
items.summary: A qualitative scoping review of 62 studies identified professional knowledge, home and everyday life, and personalization as key contextual factors and mechanisms influencing outcomes of home rehabilitation for older adults.
items.curatedReason: 设计老年居家康复服务时，别只关注技术，更要思考专业知识、居家环境和个性化如何融入。这篇综述提示我们，忽视这些情境因素，服务效果会大打折扣。
items.titleZh: 一项定性范围综述探讨居家康复在老年人背景、机制和结果方面的有效性
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 62 项研究的定性范围综述发现，专业知识和方法、居家和日常生活，以及个性化是影响老年人居家康复结果的关键情境因素和机制。
items.curatedReasonEn: When designing home rehabilitation services for older adults, don't just focus on techniques. You must integrate professional knowledge, the home environment, and personalization. This review suggests that neglecting these contextual factors will significantly compromise service effectiveness.
items.limitation: 作为定性综述，其发现侧重于体验和观点，不涉及干预措施的定量效果评估。
items.limitationEn: As a qualitative review, its findings focus on experiences and perspectives, not quantitative evaluations of intervention effectiveness.

items.title: Chart-derived frailty index is associated with long-term mortality and longitudinal health-related quality of life after hip fracture surgery in older adults: a secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
items.summary: A secondary analysis of a prospective cohort (1,072 patients) found that a higher chart-derived frailty index was associated with increased mortality (HR 2.621, 95% CI 1.935–3.549) and poorer health-related quality of life after hip fracture surgery in older adults.
items.curatedReason: 在髋部骨折老年患者术后，不要忽视衰弱状况。这项观察研究提示，如果患者的图表衍生衰弱指数（CFI）较高，死亡率将显著增加（HR 2.621），且生活质量更差。你应该将 CFI 作为一个便捷的风险筛查工具，辅助评估预后并与患者及家属进行沟通。
items.titleZh: 图表衍生衰弱指数与老年髋部骨折术后长期死亡率和纵向健康相关生活质量相关：一项前瞻性队列研究的二次分析
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性队列研究的二次分析（1,072 名患者）发现，髋部骨折老年患者较高的图表衍生衰弱指数与更高的死亡率（HR 2.621, 95% CI 1.935–3.549）和较差的健康相关生活质量相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: For older adults after hip fracture surgery, frailty status shouldn't be overlooked. This observational study suggests that a higher chart-derived frailty index (CFI) is associated with significantly increased mortality (HR 2.621) and poorer quality of life. You should use CFI as a convenient screening tool to aid in prognostic assessment and communication with patients and their families.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性队列研究的二次分析，可能存在未能控制的混杂因素，且健康相关生活质量的长期轨迹对模型设定敏感。
items.limitationEn: This is a secondary analysis of a retrospective cohort study, which may have unaddressed confounders, and the long-term trajectories of health-related quality of life were sensitive to model specification.

items.title: MRI-assessed paravertebral lumbar muscles and perceived disability in chronic low back pain: a scoping review
items.summary: A scoping review of 17 articles found inconsistent evidence regarding associations between MRI-derived paravertebral lumbar muscle characteristics and self-perceived disability in chronic non-specific low back pain, highlighting significant heterogeneity in MRI methodologies.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述揭示，MRI 评估的腰椎旁肌肉特征与慢性下腰痛感知残疾之间的关联证据不一致。你需要继续以患者感知残疾为中心进行临床评估，而 MRI 发现只能作为辅助洞察。
items.titleZh: MRI 评估的腰椎旁肌肉与慢性下腰痛感知残疾的关系：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 17 篇文章的范围综述发现，MRI 评估的腰椎旁肌肉特征与慢性非特异性下腰痛患者自我感知残疾之间的关联证据不一致，并强调了 MRI 方法学中的显著异质性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review reveals inconsistent evidence regarding the association between MRI-assessed paravertebral lumbar muscle characteristics and perceived disability in chronic low back pain. You should continue to center clinical assessment on patient-perceived disability, with MRI findings serving only as supplementary insights.
items.limitation: 作为范围综述，它主要识别了文献中的异质性，并未对证据质量进行深入评估，也未提供具体的临床诊断或干预建议。
items.limitationEn: As a scoping review, it primarily identified heterogeneity in the literature without in-depth assessment of evidence quality or specific clinical diagnostic or intervention recommendations.

items.title: How Small Clinics Can Keep Pace in an Accelerating Industry
items.summary: Small physical therapy clinics can keep pace in a competitive industry by leveraging technology to automate front desk activities, reduce documentation time from hours to minutes, and simplify billing operations.
items.curatedReason: 小型诊所可通过自动化前台任务、缩短文档记录时间、简化计费流程来提高效率，以应对日益激烈的行业竞争。你应该评估诊所现有流程，考虑引入技术解决方案来优化运营。
items.titleZh: 小型诊所如何在加速发展的行业中保持竞争力
items.summaryZh: 小型物理治疗诊所可以通过利用技术自动化前台活动、将文档记录时间从数小时缩短至数分钟，以及简化计费操作，在竞争激烈的行业中保持竞争力。
items.curatedReasonEn: Small clinics can enhance efficiency to cope with increasing industry competition by automating front desk tasks, reducing documentation time, and streamlining billing processes. You should assess your clinic's current workflows and consider implementing technological solutions to optimize operations.

items.title: Psychological readiness, active knee flexion and patient-reported knee function at 12 and 18 months after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction: a retrospective cohort study
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study (75 patients) found that higher psychological readiness was associated with higher concurrent patient-reported knee function scores after ACLR, though not a causal relationship or within-patient association.
items.curatedReason: 这项回顾性研究提示 ACLR 术后患者的心理准备与更好的膝关节功能报告相关，这支持了在术后评估中将心理因素与身体和功能指标一并考虑。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带重建术后 12 和 18 个月心理准备、主动膝关节屈曲和患者报告的膝关节功能：一项回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究（75 名患者）发现，ACLR 术后心理准备程度越高，患者报告的同期膝关节功能评分也越高，但未建立因果关系或患者内部关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This retrospective study suggests that psychological readiness is associated with better patient-reported knee function after ACLR, supporting the inclusion of psychological factors alongside physical and functional measures in postoperative assessments.
items.limitation: 研究样本量小（75 人）、单中心且为回顾性队列设计，难以确立因果关系或推论更广。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (75 participants), is single-center, and uses a retrospective cohort design, making it difficult to establish causality or generalize findings widely.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Multisite Implementation and Outcomes of KineTransForma: A Faculty-Supervised, Student-Delivered, Community-Based, Goal-Directed Home Rehabilitation Program in Chile.
items.summary: KineTransForma, a faculty-supervised, student-delivered, community-based home rehabilitation program in Chile, was feasibly implemented across 3 sites and yielded favorable functional improvements in 42 contexts (mean age 65.29 years), including Barthel Index, Elderly Mobility Scale, global strength, and Critical Functional Context-Maximum Motor Milestone distribution.
items.curatedReason: 这项在智利开展的实际项目评估表明，由学生提供、教员监督的社区居家康复模式，能有效改善老年功能依赖患者的预后。这对在资源有限地区扩展康复服务，或在现有 PT 诊所体系外建立补充模式，具有重要参考价值。
items.titleZh: 智利 KineTransForma 项目的多中心实施与成效：一项由教员监督、学生提供、社区居家、目标导向的康复计划
items.summaryZh: 智利一项由教员监督、学生提供的社区居家康复项目 KineTransForma 在三个社区场所成功实施，并在 42 个功能依赖患者（平均年龄 65.29 岁）中取得了积极的功能改善信号，包括巴氏指数、老年人移动量表、整体肌力及关键功能情境-最大运动里程碑分布的提升。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pragmatic program evaluation from Chile indicates that a student-delivered, faculty-supervised community-based home rehabilitation model can effectively improve outcomes for older adults with functional dependency. This is a valuable reference for expanding rehabilitation services in resource-constrained areas or establishing complementary models outside existing PT clinic systems.
items.limitation: 本研究采用非随机前瞻性设计，且缺乏对照组，无法完全排除混杂因素，且其结果来自智利特定社区，外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This study used a non-randomized pre-post design without a control group, limiting the ability to rule out confounding factors, and its findings from specific Chilean communities have limited generalizability.

items.title: Referral for knee pain and gait training leads to multiple sclerosis diagnosis: a case report.
items.summary: A 28-year-old male presenting with chronic knee pain and gait dysfunction was diagnosed with relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis after physical therapy evaluation revealed atypical neurological findings. His knee pain resolved with PT, while gait and balance deficits required neurological rehabilitation, highlighting coexisting etiologies.
items.curatedReason: 本病例报告提醒您在评估患者时，即便有看似合理的肌肉骨骼诊断，也要警惕并继续排查不完全符合典型表现的症状，避免诊断过早关闭。这巩固了 PT 在早期发现复杂神经系统疾病中的守门人角色。
items.titleZh: 膝关节疼痛和步态训练转诊最终诊断为多发性硬化症：一例病例报告
items.summaryZh: 一名 28 岁男性因慢性膝关节疼痛和步态功能障碍转诊，经物理治疗评估发现非典型神经系统表现后，被诊断为复发缓解型多发性硬化症。其膝关节疼痛经物理治疗解决，而步态和平衡缺陷则需神经康复，凸显了多重病因并存的可能性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case report reminds you to remain vigilant and investigate symptoms not fully explained by typical musculoskeletal findings, even when a plausible diagnosis exists. It reinforces PT's gatekeeper role in early detection of complex neurological conditions.
items.limitation: 本研究为单病例报告，结论的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report, limiting the generalizability of its findings.
items.journal: The Journal of manual & manipulative therapy

items.title: The clinical reasoning associated with prognosis and musculoskeletal disorders - A Masterclass in incorporating prognostic reasoning into physiotherapy practice.
items.summary: This masterclass provides a framework to help physiotherapists understand, determine, communicate, and re-evaluate prognosis in musculoskeletal disorders, improving clinical reasoning and patient outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 本篇「大师班」文章提供了一个框架，指导你如何在肌肉骨骼疾病患者的康复管理中，更实际、更有意义地运用预后判断，这有助于你优化患者的治疗路径。
items.titleZh: 肌肉骨骼疾病患者预后相关的临床推理：将预后推理纳入物理治疗实践的大师班
items.summaryZh: 这篇大师班文章提出了一个框架，指导物理治疗师如何理解、确定、沟通和重新评估肌肉骨骼疾病的预后，以期改善临床推理和患者结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: This "masterclass" provides a framework for physiotherapists to incorporate prognostic reasoning into musculoskeletal disorder management more practically and meaningfully, helping you optimize patient outcomes.
items.limitation: 这是一篇专家观点和框架性文章，并非基于实证研究。
items.limitationEn: This is an expert opinion and framework article, not based on empirical research.

items.title: Virtual Reality and Body Weight-Supported Treadmill Training in Gait and Balance Rehabilitation After Stroke: A Systematic Review of Randomized Controlled Trials.
items.summary: A systematic review of 15 RCTs (900 individuals) found that both Virtual Reality (VR) and Body Weight-Supported Treadmill Training (BWSTT) may improve gait and balance after stroke, with effects comparable to conventional rehabilitation, though evidence certainty is low to moderate.
items.curatedReason: 虚拟现实（VR）和体重支持跑步机训练（BWSTT）均可作为卒中后步态和平衡康复的辅助手段，且效果可能与传统康复相当。你可以考虑将这些技术整合到卒中患者的康复方案中。
items.titleZh: 虚拟现实与体重支持跑步机训练在卒中后步态和平衡康复中的应用：随机对照试验的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 15 项随机对照试验（900 名个体）的系统综述发现，虚拟现实（VR）和体重支持跑步机训练（BWSTT）均可能改善卒中后的步态和平衡，效果与传统康复相当，但证据确定性为中低等。
items.curatedReasonEn: Both Virtual Reality (VR) and Body Weight-Supported Treadmill Training (BWSTT) can serve as adjuncts for gait and balance rehabilitation after stroke, with effects potentially comparable to conventional rehabilitation. Consider integrating these technologies into stroke patient recovery plans.
items.limitation: 由于临床和方法学异质性高，本系统综述仅进行定性合成，证据确定性为中低等。
items.limitationEn: Due to high clinical and methodological heterogeneity, this systematic review only performed qualitative synthesis, and the certainty of evidence is low to moderate.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Low-Cost Visual Art in Stroke Neurorehabilitation: A Scoping Review.
items.summary: A scoping review of 42 papers explored low-cost visual art in stroke neurorehabilitation, finding it supported communication, self-expression, and improved quality of life, mood, self-efficacy, social connectedness, and fine motor/speech outcomes, though direct links to neuroplasticity remain limited.
items.curatedReason: 低成本视觉艺术干预可能在卒中患者的康复中发挥辅助作用，尤其在改善沟通、情绪、自我效能和精细运动方面，但目前仍需更多研究来明确其神经可塑性机制和临床实施指南。
items.titleZh: 卒中神经康复中的低成本视觉艺术：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述纳入 42 篇论文，发现低成本视觉艺术在卒中神经康复中支持沟通和自我表达，并改善生活质量、情绪、自我效能、社交联系以及精细运动/言语结局，但与神经可塑性的直接关联仍有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: Low-cost visual art interventions may serve as adjuncts in stroke rehabilitation, particularly for improving communication, mood, self-efficacy, and fine motor outcomes, though further research is needed to clarify neuroplasticity links and implementation guidelines.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围综述，纳入文献异质性高，且视觉艺术与神经可塑性直接关联的研究有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review with high heterogeneity among included studies, and direct research linking visual art to neuroplasticity is limited.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Effects of an 8-week progressive neuro-athletic training program on goalkeeper movement performance: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: An 8-week progressive neuro-athletic training (NAT) program, added to regular soccer training, significantly improved dynamic postural control (Y-Balance composite score: 2.74% within-group improvement, Hedges’ g = 1.07), change-of-direction performance (T-agility time decreased by 2.77%, Hedges’ g = -1.36), and countermovement jump flight time (Hedges’ g = 1.16) in 20 trained male soccer goalkeepers, compared to regular training alone.
items.curatedReason: 这项随机对照试验表明，在常规训练基础上增加为期8周的神经运动训练（NAT）能显著改善足球守门员的动态姿势控制和变向表现。如果你在运动康复领域工作，考虑将NAT作为提高运动员核心运动表现的补充干预，尤其适用于需要快速反应和协调性的运动项目。
items.titleZh: 8周渐进式神经运动训练方案对守门员运动表现影响的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验显示，在常规足球训练基础上，为期8周的渐进式神经运动训练（NAT）方案显著改善了20名训练有素的男性足球守门员的动态姿势控制（Y-平衡复合得分组内提升2.74%，Hedges’ g = 1.07）、变向表现（T-敏捷时间减少2.77%，Hedges’ g = -1.36）和反向跳跃滞空时间（Hedges’ g = 1.16）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This randomized controlled trial shows that adding an 8-week neuro-athletic training (NAT) program to regular training significantly improves dynamic postural control and change-of-direction performance in soccer goalkeepers. If you work in sports rehabilitation, consider NAT as a supplementary intervention to enhance core athletic performance, especially for sports requiring rapid reactions and coordination.
items.limitation: 对照组未接受时间匹配的主动干预，可能高估了神经运动训练的独立效果。
items.limitationEn: The control group did not receive a time-matched active intervention, which may have overestimated the isolated effect of neuro-athletic training.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: 2027 Fee Schedule Analysis: Delayed MIPS Sunset Is Welcome News for PTs
items.summary: The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) finalized several Medicare Physician Fee Schedule policies for calendar year 2027, offering welcome news for physical therapists participating in quality reporting, and providing insight into CMS' preparedness to move to quality reporting and value-based care.
items.curatedReason: CMS发布了2027年医保医师费用表最终规则的分析报告，其中MIPS日落时间延迟的消息对物理治疗师来说是积极进展。你应关注这些政策变化，调整你的质量报告策略和价值护理模式，以优化报销。
items.titleZh: 2027 年费用表分析：MIPS 日落延迟对 PT 来说是好消息
items.summaryZh: 医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心（CMS）最终确定了 2027 日历年度的几项医疗保险医师费用表政策，为参与质量报告的物理治疗师带来了好消息，并提供了 CMS 准备转向质量报告和价值型护理的见解。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS has released an analysis of the 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule final rule, with the delayed MIPS sunset being positive news for physical therapists. You should monitor these policy changes to adjust your quality reporting strategies and value-based care models to optimize reimbursement.

items.title: A machine learning-based assessment method for post-stroke dysfunction severity using the ICF-RS: a prospective study
items.summary: A machine learning framework developed using ICF-RS data from 2,812 stroke patients achieved a mean classification accuracy of 0.84 in fivefold cross-validation and 0.71 in two external validation cohorts for post-stroke dysfunction severity. The derived continuous severity score was negatively correlated with the Modified Barthel Index (r = -0.61).
items.curatedReason: 这个基于机器学习的模型能够将ICF-RS数据转化为中风后功能障碍的序数分类和连续严重度评分，有望支持个性化康复规划和更高效的资源分配。在临床实践中，可以考虑引入这类工具辅助标准化评估。
items.titleZh: 基于机器学习的 ICF-RS 中风后功能障碍严重程度评估方法：一项前瞻性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项基于2812名中风患者ICF-RS数据的机器学习框架，在五折交叉验证中实现了0.84的平均分类准确率，在两个外部验证队列中实现了0.71的准确率，用于评估中风后功能障碍的严重程度。导出的连续严重度评分与改良Barthel指数呈负相关（r = -0.61）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This machine learning-based model can convert ICF-RS data into ordinal classifications and continuous severity scores for post-stroke dysfunction, potentially supporting personalized rehabilitation planning and more efficient resource allocation. In clinical practice, consider incorporating such tools to aid standardized assessment.
items.limitation: 模型在外部验证队列中的准确性低于内部交叉验证，提示其泛化能力仍有提升空间。
items.limitationEn: The model's accuracy in external validation cohorts was lower than in internal cross-validation, suggesting room for improvement in generalizability.

items.title: Physiatry-physiotherapy interdisciplinary project (PHY 2 ): Service evaluation of a new caregiving model for musculoskeletal pain by advanced practice physiotherapists in the physiatry department.
items.summary: A single-center prospective descriptive cohort study found that advanced practice physiotherapists (APPs) could independently manage 41% (n=124/300) of musculoskeletal patients referred to a physiatry department, with 24% discharged after the first evaluation. Patients discharged by APPs had significantly higher SF-36 scores (53 vs. 36) and better condition-specific PROM scores than those referred to physiatry.
items.curatedReason: 高级实践物理治疗师（APP）在康复科门诊独立评估和管理大部分肌肉骨骼患者，能有效分流，并使转诊到理疗师的患者获得更高的满意度。这是优化康复医疗服务交付，缓解医务人员工作量的有效模式。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗师高级实践项目 (PHY2)：高级实践物理治疗师在康复医学科肌肉骨骼疼痛患者新护理模式的服务评估
items.summaryZh: 一项单中心前瞻性队列研究显示，高级实践物理治疗师（APP）能独立管理康复医学科转诊肌肉骨骼患者的41%（n=124/300），其中24%在首次评估后即出院。由APP出院的患者SF-36评分（53 vs. 36）和特定疾病PROM评分均显著高于转诊至康复科医师的患者。
items.curatedReasonEn: Advanced Practice Physiotherapists (APPs) can effectively triage and independently manage a significant proportion of musculoskeletal patients in physiatry outpatient settings, leading to higher patient satisfaction for those referred to physiatrists. This model optimizes rehabilitation service delivery and alleviates clinician workload.
items.limitation: 单中心前瞻性队列研究，可能存在选择偏倚，且结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center prospective descriptive cohort study, which may have selection bias and limited generalizability.

items.title: General Archives - BJSM blog - social media's leading SEM voice
items.summary: This page provides an archive of BJSM blog posts, with topics including emergency care in sailing, hamstring strain injuries, traditional Chinese exercises for musculoskeletal disorders, a new algorithm for Achilles tendon rupture management (CARTA), a faster concussion exam (mSIT+), exercise recommendations for heart health, exercise prescription for tendinopathy, and sudden cardiac arrest preparedness in African football.
items.curatedReason: 这是一篇博文归档页，涵盖了多篇关于运动医学和康复的短文。其中提到了中医运动对肌肉骨骼疾病的帮助、腘绳肌损伤的复发率、以及个性化跟腱断裂管理的新算法，可供你快速了解行业动态。
items.titleZh: 综合档案 - BJSM 博客 - 社交媒体领先的 SEM 声音
items.summaryZh: 本页面提供了 BJSM 博客文章的档案，主题包括帆船运动中的紧急护理、腠绳肌拉伤、用于肌肉骨骼疾病的传统中医锻炼、一种新的跟腱断裂管理算法 (CARTA)、一种更快的脑震荡检查 (mSIT+)、心脏健康锻炼建议、肌腱病锻炼处方，以及非洲足球中的心脏骤停准备工作。
items.curatedReasonEn: This blog archive page features several short articles on sports medicine and rehabilitation. It covers topics such as the benefits of traditional Chinese exercises for musculoskeletal disorders, hamstring injury recurrence rates, and a new algorithm for personalized Achilles tendon rupture management, offering a quick overview of industry news.

items.title: Therapy Performance Predicts Functional Recovery After Stroke.
items.summary: Therapy performance metrics (TPMs) extracted from clinical notes using machine learning predict functional discharge outcomes in stroke patients (n=42) as early as 5-7 days post-admission, with R² values of 0.64-0.78 for 10MWT, 6MWT, and BBS. Incorporating TPMs improved 6MWT prediction from R²=0.30 to 0.63, reducing error by ~25 m.
items.curatedReason: 本研究利用机器学习从临床笔记中提取治疗表现指标（TPMs），大幅提升了卒中患者出院功能恢复的早期预测能力。这提示未来可通过常规临床数据实现更动态、实时的康复预测和个性化方案调整。
items.titleZh: 治疗表现指标预测卒中后功能恢复
items.summaryZh: 一项对42名卒中患者的观察研究显示，从临床笔记中提取的治疗表现指标（TPMs）可早在入院后5-7天预测出院时的功能结局，与10MWT、6MWT和BBS的出院分数强相关（R²=0.64-0.78）。将TPMs纳入机器学习模型显著提高了预测能力，6MWT的R²从0.30增至0.63，预测误差减少约25米。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study significantly enhances early prediction of functional recovery post-stroke by extracting Therapy Performance Metrics (TPMs) from clinical notes using machine learning. This suggests future potential for dynamic, real-time rehabilitation prediction and personalized intervention adjustments from routine clinical data.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（42例），且为单中心研究，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (42 participants) and is single-center, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Efficacy of action observation therapy in patients with dementia or cognitive impairment: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized trials.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 9 RCTs (348 patients) found action observation therapy (AOT) significantly improved cognitive function (SMD=0.86), activities of daily living (SMD=0.67), and naming aphasia (SMD=0.53) in patients with dementia or cognitive impairment. AOT also improved motor function (gait velocity SMD=0.70, TUG SMD=-1.05) in dementia patients without stroke.
items.curatedReason: 对于认知障碍或痴呆患者，你应考虑将动作观察疗法（AOT）纳入康复方案。这项包含9项RCT的系统综述和荟萃分析显示，AOT能显著改善认知功能、日常生活活动和命名性失语，并能改善无卒中痴呆患者的步态速度和TUG测试表现。
items.titleZh: 观察动作疗法对痴呆或认知障碍患者的疗效：一项随机试验的系统综述和Meta分析
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖9项随机对照试验（348名患者）的系统综述和Meta分析显示，观察动作疗法（AOT）显著改善了痴呆或认知障碍患者的认知功能（SMD=0.86）、日常生活活动（SMD=0.67）和命名性失语（SMD=0.53）。此外，AOT还改善了无卒中痴呆患者的运动功能（步速SMD=0.70，TUG SMD=-1.05）。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients with dementia or cognitive impairment, you should consider integrating Action Observation Therapy (AOT) into their rehabilitation. This systematic review and meta-analysis of 9 RCTs found AOT significantly improves cognitive function, activities of daily living, and naming aphasia, alongside improving gait velocity and TUG scores in dementia patients without stroke.
items.limitation: Meta分析中不同研究的异质性可能影响结果的综合解释，且部分亚组分析样本量较小。
items.limitationEn: Heterogeneity across studies in the meta-analysis may affect the overall interpretation of results, and some subgroup analyses had small sample sizes.

items.title: Effect of the timing and setting of pulmonary rehabilitation on functional recovery after lung cancer surgery: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials found late-phase pulmonary rehabilitation significantly improved 6-minute walk distance (MD=68.86 m, 95% CI 53.46-84.26), peak oxygen uptake (MD=2.62 ml/kg/min), and FEV1 (MD=0.52 L) after lung cancer surgery. Early in-hospital rehabilitation did not reduce complications or shorten hospital stay. Partially supervised modes were comparable to fully supervised.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述明确指出，肺癌术后开展的晚期（出院后）肺康复可显著改善患者的运动能力和肺功能。相反，早期（住院期间）康复的短期益处不明显。这提示我们应更侧重于出院后的康复方案，并可考虑部分监督模式以提高可行性。
items.titleZh: 肺康复时间与设置对肺癌术后功能恢复影响的系统综述与Meta分析
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖随机对照试验的系统综述和Meta分析显示，肺癌术后晚期肺康复显著改善了6分钟步行距离（MD=68.86米, 95% CI 53.46-84.26）、峰值摄氧量（MD=2.62 ml/kg/min）和FEV1（MD=0.52升）。早期住院康复未能显著降低并发症或缩短住院时间。部分监督模式与完全监督模式在效果上无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review clearly indicates that late-phase (post-discharge) pulmonary rehabilitation significantly improves exercise capacity and pulmonary function after lung cancer surgery. Conversely, early (in-hospital) rehabilitation shows no clear short-term benefits. This suggests a greater focus on post-discharge rehabilitation programs, with partially supervised models as a feasible option.
items.limitation: 不同研究间在康复方案的强度、持续时间以及患者基线特征上可能存在异质性。
items.limitationEn: Heterogeneity in rehabilitation protocols, duration, and patient baseline characteristics might exist across different studies.

items.title: 3D Biomechanics of Anterior Cruciate Ligament Injuries in Football: What We Have Learned in the Last Five Years.
items.summary: This review synthesizes findings from five years of research on 3D biomechanics of ACL injuries in elite male football players (n=33). It highlights multiplanar knee rotations (flexion, abduction, internal/external rotation) and context-dependent whole-body kinematics leading to injury, proposing biomechanically informed mitigation strategies.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述总结了近五年关于足球运动员 ACL 损伤生物力学的最新理解，揭示了多平面关节旋转和全身体态的复杂性。理解这些细致的运动学特征有助于我们设计更精准的预防和康复策略，尤其是针对运动情境下的特定风险。
items.titleZh: 足球运动中前交叉韧带损伤的3D生物力学：近五年我们学到了什么
items.summaryZh: 这项综述综合了过去五年对精英男性足球运动员（n=33）前交叉韧带（ACL）损伤3D生物力学的研究发现。它强调了导致损伤的多平面膝关节旋转（屈曲、外展、内外旋）和情境依赖的全身运动学特征，并提出了基于生物力学的损伤缓解策略。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review summarizes the latest understanding of ACL injury biomechanics in football players over the past five years, revealing the complexity of multiplanar joint rotations and whole-body kinematics. Understanding these nuanced kinematic features helps in designing more precise prevention and rehabilitation strategies, especially for sport-specific risks.
items.limitation: 研究为叙述性综述，缺乏系统性的证据筛选与综合，结论可能存在偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, lacking systematic evidence screening and synthesis, and conclusions may be subject to bias.

items.title: Exploratory analysis of the impact of age stratification on outcomes of combined Salter osteotomy and femoral osteotomy in pediatric developmental dysplasia of the hip using a 3-year cutoff.
items.summary: A retrospective study (n=65) comparing combined Salter osteotomy and femoral osteotomy for pediatric DDH found that patients under 3 years had superior acetabular index and center-edge angle changes (P<0.001), significantly more excellent Severin (97.1% vs. 74.2%, P=0.002) and McKay (97.1% vs. 64.5%) results, and lower avascular necrosis risk (0% vs. 12.9%, P<0.05) than those aged 3 years or older, despite older patients having more severe baseline dysplasia.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提示，对于儿童发育性髋关节发育不良（DDH）患者，3岁前进行Salter截骨联合股骨截骨术，可能获得更好的功能结局和更低的股骨头坏死风险。这进一步支持了早期干预的重要性，但需注意其观察性研究的局限性。
items.titleZh: 年龄分层对小儿发育性髋关节发育不良联合Salter截骨和股骨截骨术预后影响的探索性分析：以3年为界限
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性研究（n=65）比较了小儿发育性髋关节发育不良（DDH）患者联合Salter截骨和股骨截骨术的预后，发现3岁以下患者在髋臼指数和中心边缘角改善方面更优（P<0.001），Severin（97.1% vs. 74.2%，P=0.002）和McKay（97.1% vs. 64.5%）评级为优的比例显著更高，股骨头坏死风险更低（0% vs. 12.9%，P<0.05），尽管年龄较大组基线发育不良程度更重。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that children with developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH) undergoing combined Salter and femoral osteotomy before age 3 may achieve better functional outcomes and lower avascular necrosis risk. This further supports the importance of early intervention, but its observational design limits causality claims.
items.limitation: 该研究为回顾性观察研究，存在选择偏倚和混杂因素，且年龄分层后的多变量回归分析结果不稳定。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective observational study with selection bias and confounding factors, and multivariable regression results after age stratification were unstable.

items.title: Impact of Adding Fatigue-Focused Cognitive Behavior Therapy to Supervised Pilates-Based Core Stability Training on Balance and Walking in Patients with Multiple Sclerosis: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A double-blind RCT found adding cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) to supervised Pilates-based core stability training significantly improved balance and gait more than Pilates alone. After 8 weeks, the study group showed greater reduction in overall stability index (mean difference -0.59, 95% CI: -0.70 to -0.48; p < .001) and increase in cadence (mean difference 8.22 steps/min, 95% CI: 4.40 to 12.04; p < .001) compared to the control group.
items.curatedReason: 本项RCT有力证明了在多发性硬化症（MS）患者的普拉提核心稳定性训练中加入以疲劳为重点的认知行为疗法（CBT），能显著优于单独普拉提训练，在平衡和步态参数上带来更大的改善。整体稳定性指数和步频的显著提升，为MS患者的康复提供了更有效的干预策略。考虑在临床中为MS患者提供普拉提时，引入CBT以提升平衡和步态功能。
items.titleZh: 疲劳为重点的认知行为疗法联合普拉提核心稳定性训练对多发性硬化症患者平衡和步态的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项双盲随机对照试验发现，在普拉提核心稳定性训练中加入认知行为疗法（CBT）比单独普拉提训练能更显著地改善平衡和步态。8周后，研究组的整体稳定性指数下降更多（平均差 -0.59, 95% CI: -0.70 to -0.48; p < .001），步频增加更多（平均差 8.22 步/分钟, 95% CI: 4.40 to 12.04; p < .001），相较于对照组。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT strongly demonstrates that adding fatigue-focused cognitive behavior therapy (CBT) to supervised Pilates-based core stability training in multiple sclerosis (MS) patients significantly outperforms Pilates alone, leading to greater improvements in balance and walking parameters. The notable enhancements in overall stability index and cadence offer a more effective intervention strategy for MS rehabilitation. Consider incorporating CBT with Pilates for MS patients in clinical practice to enhance balance and gait function.
items.limitation: 本研究的长期随访结果未知，且是在单一中心进行，可能限制了结果的外推性。
items.limitationEn: Long-term follow-up results are unknown, and the study was conducted at a single center, which may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Improvement in functional movement, landing mechanics, and dynamic balance following TRX training in physically active athletes after ACL reconstruction: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial found a 6-week TRX suspension training program significantly improved dynamic balance (e.g., anterior reach: F=33.527, p<0.001), movement quality (FMS scores: F=251.994, p<0.001), and landing mechanics (LESS scores: F=75.385, p<0.001) more than traditional rehabilitation in male athletes after ACL reconstruction.
items.curatedReason: 本项随机对照试验明确指出，在ACL重建术后的康复中，TRX悬吊训练比传统康复更能显著改善运动员的功能性动作、着陆力学和动态平衡。这些结果提示TRX训练作为高级康复阶段的干预手段，应被考虑纳入重返运动前的康复方案，以提升患者的运动表现和安全性。
items.titleZh: ACL重建术后体能活跃运动员TRX训练对功能性动作、着陆力学和动态平衡的改善：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验发现，为期六周的TRX悬吊训练方案在ACL重建术后的男性运动员中，相比传统康复，显著改善了动态平衡（如前向伸展：F=33.527, p<0.001）、动作质量（FMS评分：F=251.994, p<0.001）和着陆力学（LESS评分：F=75.385, p<0.001）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This randomized controlled trial clearly indicates that TRX suspension training significantly improves functional movement, landing mechanics, and dynamic balance in athletes after ACL reconstruction, outperforming traditional rehabilitation. These results suggest TRX training should be considered for advanced rehabilitation phases before return to sport to enhance patient performance and safety.
items.limitation: 本研究随访时间较短，长期效果和重返运动后再次损伤率未知，且研究对象仅限男性运动员。
items.limitationEn: The study has a short follow-up period, with unknown long-term effects and re-injury rates after return to sport, and participants were exclusively male athletes.

items.title: Patients treated with rehabilitation alone after anterior cruciate ligament injury display greater muscle strength symmetry, yet lower absolute muscle strength normalized to bodyweight compared to reconstruction: A Cross-sectional study of 3,093 patients.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 3,093 ACL patients (2707 ACLR; 386 rehabilitation) found that those treated with rehabilitation alone had greater muscle strength symmetry at all follow-ups but lower absolute strength normalized to bodyweight in the uninjured limb. They also reported higher KOOS symptoms but inferior knee self-efficacy compared to ACLR patients.
items.curatedReason: 本项基于大型注册数据的研究发现，仅接受康复治疗的ACL损伤患者比接受ACL重建的患者表现出更好的肌肉力量对称性，但在未受伤肢体的绝对肌力（标准化到体重）上较低。这提示我们在选择治疗方案时，除了患者年龄和活动水平，还需综合考虑患者的肌力特征和自我效能预期，并针对性地进行康复干预。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带损伤后仅接受康复治疗的患者与重建手术患者相比，肌肉力量对称性更高，但绝对肌力（标准化到体重）较低：一项对3,093名患者的横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对3,093例前交叉韧带（ACL）损伤患者（2707例重建术后；386例仅康复）的横断面研究发现，仅接受康复治疗的患者在所有随访中均表现出更好的肌肉力量对称性，但在未受伤肢体的绝对肌力（标准化到体重）上较低。与ACL重建患者相比，他们还报告了更高的KOOS症状评分，但膝关节自我效能感较差。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large registry-based study found that ACL injury patients treated with rehabilitation alone exhibited greater muscle strength symmetry but lower absolute strength (normalized to bodyweight) in the uninjured limb compared to those undergoing ACL reconstruction. This suggests that when selecting treatment, beyond age and activity level, clinicians should consider muscle strength characteristics and self-efficacy expectations, and tailor rehabilitation interventions accordingly.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性队列研究，虽然样本量大，但存在选择偏倚，可能无法完全控制患者在治疗选择上的初始差异。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective cohort study, and despite a large sample size, it may be subject to selection bias, potentially not fully controlling for initial differences in treatment choices among patients.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Comparative diagnostic utility of SPECT-CT versus MRI and CT in chronic low back pain.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study (n=122 patients, 610 levels) found SPECT-CT positivity was moderately and independently associated with Modic changes (OR 6.40, 95% CI 3.09-13.27), Pfirrmann 4-5 (OR 17.27, 95% CI 3.80-78.46), and vacuum disc (OR 2.69, 95% CI 1.30-5.58) in chronic low back pain. However, findings were frequently discordant, with 60.7% of Pfirrmann 4-5 levels being SPECT-EP-negative.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提示，SPECT-CT在慢性腰痛诊断中可能补充MRI和CT的结构性发现。虽然SPECT-CT阳性与Modic改变、Pfirrmann分级和真空盘/关节现象中度相关，但三种影像学结果存在明显不一致，这提醒我们不能将代谢和结构发现互换。未来需基于结局的验证才能明确SPECT-CT在识别有症状节段中的作用。
items.titleZh: SPECT-CT与MRI和CT在慢性腰痛诊断中的比较诊断效用
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究（122名患者，610个节段）发现，在慢性腰痛中，SPECT-CT阳性与Modic改变（OR 6.40, 95% CI 3.09-13.27）、Pfirrmann 4-5级（OR 17.27, 95% CI 3.80-78.46）和真空盘现象（OR 2.69, 95% CI 1.30-5.58）中度且独立相关。然而，影像学结果经常不一致，60.7%的Pfirrmann 4-5级节段SPECT-EP阴性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests SPECT-CT may complement MRI and CT structural findings in chronic low back pain diagnosis. While SPECT-CT positivity is moderately associated with Modic changes, Pfirrmann grade, and vacuum disc/facet phenomena, significant discordance exists among the three imaging modalities, indicating that metabolic and structural findings are not interchangeable. Future outcome-based validation is needed to clarify SPECT-CT's role in identifying symptomatic levels.
items.limitation: 本研究是回顾性单机构队列研究，可能存在选择偏倚，且未能通过结局验证SPECT-CT阳性是否识别了有症状的椎体节段。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective single-institution cohort study, potentially subject to selection bias, and it did not validate whether SPECT-CT positivity identified symptomatic levels through outcome measures.
items.journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society

items.title: Injury risk and physical therapy utilization following knee surgery in U.S. Army soldiers: a comparison of military and non-military treatment facilities.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study (n=4924 U.S. Army soldiers) found that 75% sustained a subsequent injury within 1-3 years of knee surgery. Soldiers treated at non-military treatment facilities (32%) had higher injury rates (79% vs. 73%) and longer physical therapy duration (8.3 vs. 7.1 weeks; p = 0.038) compared to those treated at military treatment facilities (MTFs), with adjusted odds of subsequent injury being 1.22 (95% CI [1.04-1.44]) higher at non-MTFs.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对美国陆军士兵的回顾性研究显示，在非军事医疗机构（非MTFs）接受膝关节手术的士兵，其后续受伤风险和物理治疗时长均高于在军事医疗机构（MTFs）接受治疗的士兵。这些发现提示治疗环境可能影响康复结局，对需要康复的现役军人，应考量医疗机构的选择。
items.titleZh: 美国陆军士兵膝关节手术后损伤风险和物理治疗利用情况：军事与非军事医疗机构的比较
items.summaryZh: 一项对4924名美国陆军士兵的回顾性队列研究发现，75%的士兵在膝关节手术后1-3年内发生后续损伤。在非军事医疗机构（32%）接受治疗的士兵，其损伤率（79% vs. 73%）和物理治疗时长（8.3 vs. 7.1周；p = 0.038）均高于在军事医疗机构接受治疗的士兵，调整后非军事医疗机构的后续损伤几率高出1.22倍（95% CI [1.04-1.44]）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This retrospective study of U.S. Army soldiers shows that those undergoing knee surgery at non-military treatment facilities (non-MTFs) had higher subsequent injury rates and longer physical therapy durations than those treated at military treatment facilities (MTFs). These findings suggest that treatment settings may influence rehabilitation outcomes, and the choice of facility should be considered for active-duty servicemembers requiring rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性队列研究，可能存在混杂因素，且未深入探讨导致MTF与非MTF之间差异的具体原因。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective cohort study, potentially subject to confounding factors, and it did not delve into the specific reasons for the differences observed between MTFs and non-MTFs.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Should Nerve Transfer Surgery be the Standard of Care for Cervical Spinal Cord Injury?
items.summary: A critical analysis of the literature highlights nerve transfer surgery as a promising intervention for improving upper limb function following cervical spinal cord injury, with generally positive aggregate outcomes but variable individual responses. It also discusses peri-operative challenges, potential benefits of combining nerve and tendon transfer, and the impact on spasticity.
items.curatedReason: 本述评肯定了神经转移手术在改善脊髓颈段损伤患者上肢功能方面的潜力，但同时强调仍存在知识空白，尤其是在最佳手术时机、康复方案和结局变异性方面。临床实践中，应将神经转移手术视为一种有前景但仍需个体化考量的治疗选项，并在康复中注意结合腱转移和痉挛管理。
items.titleZh: 神经转移手术是否应成为颈脊髓损伤的标准治疗？
items.summaryZh: 一项对文献的批判性分析强调，神经转移手术是改善颈脊髓损伤后上肢功能的有前景的干预措施，总体结局积极但个体反应存在差异。该分析还讨论了围手术期挑战、联合神经和肌腱转移的潜在益处，以及其对痉挛的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary affirms the potential of nerve transfer surgery to improve upper limb function in cervical spinal cord injury patients but also highlights existing knowledge gaps, particularly regarding optimal surgical timing, rehabilitation protocols, and outcome variability. In clinical practice, nerve transfer surgery should be considered a promising but individualized treatment option, with attention to combining tendon transfer and spasticity management in rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为专家述评，基于现有文献进行分析，缺乏新的实证数据支持。
items.limitationEn: This is an expert commentary based on existing literature analysis, lacking new empirical data.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Aqua Steps: A Feasibility Study of a new Aquatic Exercise Therapy Intervention for Falls Prevention in Older Adults.
items.summary: A feasibility study (n=101 older adults at high falls risk) for the Aqua Steps aquatic exercise intervention showed high feasibility (88% retention, 90% adherence) and safety. After 16 weeks, falls, fallers, and frequent fallers were reduced by 38%, 36%, and 58% respectively, with significant improvements in functional (22%-70%) and strength (10%-80%) tests, falls efficacy (11%), and balance confidence (8%).
items.curatedReason: 本项可行性研究表明，Aqua Steps水上运动疗法在老年人防跌倒方面具有很高的可行性、可接受性和安全性，并初步显示出减少跌倒和改善功能、力量和平衡的潜力。这些积极发现支持开展更大规模的试验以确认其效果，对未来跌倒预防运动政策的制定有重要参考价值。
items.titleZh: Aqua Steps：一项针对老年人跌倒预防新型水上运动疗法干预的可行性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对101名高跌倒风险老年人的Aqua Steps水上运动干预可行性研究显示出高可行性（88%保留率，90%依从性）和安全性。16周后，跌倒次数、跌倒者和频繁跌倒者分别减少38%、36%和58%，功能（22%-70%）和力量（10%-80%）测试、跌倒效能（11%）和平衡信心（8%）均有显著改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This feasibility study demonstrates that Aqua Steps aquatic exercise therapy is highly feasible, acceptable, and safe for fall prevention in older adults, and shows preliminary potential for reducing falls and improving function, strength, and balance. These positive findings support larger trials to confirm its efficacy and are valuable for future fall prevention exercise policy development.
items.limitation: 本研究是可行性研究，样本量相对较小，且缺乏长期随访数据，初步结果需在大型RCT中进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a feasibility study with a relatively small sample size and lacks long-term follow-up data; preliminary results require further validation in larger RCTs.

items.title: Association of outpatient waiting time with pain intensity and coping strategies in patients with nonspecific chronic low back pain scheduled for physiotherapy.
items.summary: A prospective observational study (n=60) found outpatient waiting time (OWT) negatively correlated with catastrophizing on arrival (ρ=-0.78, p < .001) in NSCLBP patients. OWT was also associated with patient satisfaction (χ2 = 9.11, p = .028), and while pain increased during OWT, multimodal physiotherapy improved pain and coping strategies.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提示，门诊等待时间与患者的灾难化思维和婚姻状况相关，并可能影响患者对治疗的满意度。尽管疼痛强度在等待期间可能增加，但多模式物理治疗仍能改善疼痛、灾难化思维和再解释策略。这些发现强调了尽量减少门诊物理治疗等待时间的重要性。
items.titleZh: 门诊等待时间与非特异性慢性腰痛物理治疗患者疼痛强度及应对策略的关联
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性观察性研究（n=60）发现，在非特异性慢性腰痛患者中，门诊等待时间（OWT）与就诊时的灾难化思维呈负相关（ρ=-0.78, p < .001），并与患者满意度相关（χ2 = 9.11, p = .028）。虽然疼痛强度在等待期间可能增加，但多模式物理治疗能改善疼痛和应对策略。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that outpatient waiting time is associated with patients' catastrophizing and marital status, and may impact treatment satisfaction. Although pain intensity may increase during waiting, multimodal physiotherapy can still improve pain, catastrophizing, and reinterpretation. These findings highlight the importance of minimizing delays in outpatient physiotherapy visits.
items.limitation: 本研究为前瞻性观察性研究，样本量较小（n=60），可能存在混杂因素，且仅在一个教学医院进行，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a prospective observational study with a small sample size (n=60), potential confounding factors, and limited generalizability as it was conducted at a single teaching hospital.

items.title: How do patients, physiotherapists and orthopedic surgeons perceive delayed recovery during total knee arthroplasty rehabilitation? A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored perceptions of delayed recovery during total knee arthroplasty (TKA) rehabilitation among patients (n=6), physiotherapists (n=6), and orthopedic surgeons (n=5). Patients prioritized pain relief, physiotherapists prioritized physical function, and surgeons prioritized patient satisfaction, highlighting differences in identifying delayed recovery and prognostic factors.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了患者、物理治疗师和骨科医生在全膝关节置换术（TKA）康复延迟的认知上存在差异。临床实践中需要建立关于何时以及如何将TKA康复视为延迟的共识，并关注患者预期作为潜在的治疗目标，以优化康复结果。
items.titleZh: 全膝关节置换术康复期间，患者、物理治疗师和骨科医生如何看待康复延迟？一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了患者（n=6）、物理治疗师（n=6）和骨科医生（n=5）对全膝关节置换术（TKA）康复延迟的看法。研究发现，患者优先关注疼痛缓解，物理治疗师关注身体功能，而外科医生关注患者满意度，揭示了在识别康复延迟和预后因素方面的认知差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals discrepancies in how patients, physiotherapists, and orthopedic surgeons perceive delayed recovery after total knee arthroplasty (TKA). Clinical practice needs consensus on when and how to consider TKA recovery delayed, with patient expectations as a potential treatment target to optimize rehabilitation outcomes.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量较小，且参与者来自特定背景，可能限制了发现的可推广性。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size and participants from specific backgrounds, which may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: What do physiotherapists need to effectively integrate a biopsychosocial approach in treatment of patients with non-specific low back pain? A qualitative analysis.
items.summary: A qualitative study (n=15 Swiss outpatient physiotherapists) identified four interconnected themes for effectively integrating biopsychosocial approaches in non-specific low back pain treatment: a supportive systemic framework, stronger interdisciplinary collaboration, enhanced educational approaches, and foundational professional attributes.
items.curatedReason: 将生物心理社会方法融入非特异性腰痛治疗，远不只是个人技能问题。这项对15名理疗师的定性研究提示我们，宏观的系统框架、中观的跨学科协作与教育支持，以及微观的专业素质，缺一不可。这意味着推行这一模式时，不能只关注个人培训，更要同步改革系统、促进协作。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗师需要什么才能有效整合生物心理社会方法治疗非特异性腰痛？一项定性分析
items.summaryZh: 一项针对15位瑞士门诊物理治疗师的定性研究，确定了在非特异性腰痛治疗中有效整合生物心理社会方法的四个相互关联主题：支持性系统框架、加强跨学科合作、改进教育方法以及核心专业素质。
items.curatedReasonEn: Integrating biopsychosocial approaches for non-specific low back pain is more than just an individual skill set. This qualitative study of 15 physiotherapists suggests that a supportive systemic framework, stronger interdisciplinary collaboration and enhanced educational approaches, alongside foundational professional attributes, are all essential. This implies that promoting this model requires systemic and collaborative reforms, not just individual training.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量较小（n=15），且仅针对瑞士门诊物理治疗师，结果的普适性有待进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (n=15) and was conducted only among Swiss outpatient physiotherapists, so the generalizability of the findings needs further validation.

items.title: Effects of neuromuscular electrical stimulation applied simultaneously with exercise therapy in patellofemoral pain: A single-blind, randomized, sham-controlled pilot trial.
items.summary: A single-blind, randomized, sham-controlled pilot trial (n=30) found no additional benefit of simultaneous neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) plus exercise therapy versus exercise plus sham for patellofemoral pain. No significant between-group benefits were seen for pain (p = .96), AKPS (p = .26), YBT (p = .28), or quadriceps strength, though total quadriceps muscle thickness increased slightly in the NMES group (p = .03; Cohen's d = -0.27).
items.curatedReason: 本项RCT结果显示，在髌股疼痛（PFP）患者的运动疗法中额外加入同步神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）并未带来额外的短期疼痛缓解或功能改善。虽然股四头肌肌厚略有增加，但临床意义尚不明确。因此，目前不建议常规将NMES作为PFP运动疗法的附加手段。
items.titleZh: 神经肌肉电刺激联合运动疗法治疗髌股疼痛的疗效：一项单盲、随机、假对照初步试验
items.summaryZh: 一项单盲、随机、假对照初步试验（n=30）发现，神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）联合运动疗法对髌股疼痛患者的疼痛（p = .96）、AKPS（p = .26）、YBT（p = .28）或股四头肌力量没有额外益处。尽管NMES组的股四头肌总肌厚略有增加（p = .03; Cohen's d = -0.27），但其临床意义不确定。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT indicates that adding simultaneous neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) to exercise therapy for patellofemoral pain (PFP) did not yield additional short-term pain relief or functional improvement. While quadriceps muscle thickness showed a small increase, its clinical relevance is uncertain. Therefore, routine addition of NMES to PFP exercise therapy is not supported.
items.limitation: 本研究是一项小型初步试验（n=30），随访时间短，可能无法检测到小效应量或长期益处。
items.limitationEn: This is a small pilot trial (n=30) with a short follow-up period, which may not detect small effect sizes or long-term benefits.

items.title: Who am I now? Experienced changes of occupational identity after spinal cord injury.
items.summary: A qualitative interview study (n=6 adults with SCI) explored the experiences of redeveloping occupational identity after spinal cord injury. Findings indicated uncertainty and a dynamic process captured by the theme "Landing or not landing in a new identity," highlighting the tension between holding on to a pre-injury identity and allowing a new one to emerge.
items.curatedReason: 本项定性研究强调了脊髓损伤（SCI）患者职业认同再发展的动态性和不确定性，以及支持这一过程的人本康复、协调干预和终生随访的重要性。它提醒临床医师，应关注患者在SCI后自我价值和叙事探索，以更好地支持其职业认同发展。
items.titleZh: “我现在是谁？”脊髓损伤后职业认同的变化体验
items.summaryZh: 一项定性访谈研究（n=6名脊髓损伤成人）探讨了脊髓损伤后职业认同再发展的经历。研究发现，这一过程充满不确定性和动态性，被主题“降落或未降落在新身份中”所概括，凸显了在保留损伤前身份和允许新身份出现之间的张力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights the dynamic and uncertain process of occupational identity redevelopment in spinal cord injury (SCI) patients, and the importance of person-centered rehabilitation, coordinated interventions, and lifelong follow-up to support this process. It reminds clinicians to focus on patients' self-worth and narrative exploration after SCI to better support their occupational identity development.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小（n=6），结果主要反映受访者的个人经验，可能不具普适性。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (n=6), and the results primarily reflect the personal experiences of the interviewees, which may not be universally applicable.

items.title: A Qualitative Study Investigating Sex Differences in the Needs and Priorities of Lower Limb Prosthesis Users
items.summary: A qualitative study interviewed 18 lower limb prosthesis users (9 female, 9 male) to investigate sex differences in their needs and priorities. Themes emerged in prosthetic, physical, psychosocial, and financial experiences, with sex differences observed in all but the financial category, highlighting female-specific challenges in prosthetic fit, ambulation, and psychosocial aspects like frustrations with clinicians and concerns regarding maternity.
items.curatedReason: 本项定性研究揭示了下肢假肢使用者在需求和优先事项方面存在性别差异，尤其在假肢适配、行走挑战和心理社会经历方面。这些发现为未来的性别特异性康复和假肢设计提供了重要依据，提示临床实践中应更关注女性假肢使用者的独特需求，以提供个性化的康复护理。
items.titleZh: 一项调查下肢假肢使用者需求和优先事项性别差异的定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究访谈了18位下肢假肢使用者（9名女性，9名男性），以调查其需求和优先事项的性别差异。研究在假肢、身体、心理社会和经济经验中发现了主题，除经济方面外，其余均存在性别差异，凸显了女性在假肢适配、行走以及对临床医生的不满和对生育的担忧等心理社会方面的独特挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals sex differences in the needs and priorities of lower limb prosthesis users, particularly concerning prosthetic fit, ambulation challenges, and psychosocial experiences. These findings provide a crucial basis for future sex-specific rehabilitation and prosthetic design, suggesting that clinical practice should pay more attention to the unique needs of female prosthesis users to provide individualized rehabilitation care.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量较小（9名女性，9名男性），结果的普适性需更多量化研究验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (9 females, 9 males), and the generalizability of its findings requires validation through more quantitative research.

items.title: Response to letter to the editor regarding 'barriers and facilitators of decision-making in home-based rehabilitation exercise among older adults following total knee arthroplasty: A qualitative study'.
items.summary: This is a response to a letter to the editor regarding a qualitative study on barriers and facilitators of decision-making in home-based rehabilitation exercise among older adults following total knee arthroplasty.
items.curatedReason: 这是一篇对社论的回复，本身不包含新的研究证据或临床实践指南，信息增量较小。
items.titleZh: 对“全膝关节置换术后老年人居家康复锻炼决策障碍与促进因素：一项定性研究”编辑来信的回应
items.summaryZh: 这是对一篇编辑来信的回应，该信件涉及一项关于全膝关节置换术后老年人居家康复锻炼决策障碍与促进因素的定性研究。
items.curatedReasonEn: This is a response to a letter to the editor and does not contain new research evidence or clinical practice guidelines, thus offering minimal new information.

items.title: A meta-analysis of 8 RCTs (n=2548) on extended window IVT (4.
items.summary: A meta-analysis of 8 RCTs (n=2548) on extended window IVT (4.5-24 hours) for acute ischemic stroke found IVT significantly increased the odds of 90-day mRS 0-1 (OR 1.45, 95% CI 1.23-1.72). It also increased early neurological improvement (OR 1.59) but did not significantly improve 90-day mRS 0-2.
items.curatedReason: 这项纳入 8 个 RCT、2548 名患者的荟萃分析明确指出，在急性缺血性卒中发作 4.5 至 24 小时内进行静脉溶栓（IVT），可显著提高患者 90 天良好功能预后（mRS 0-1）的几率（OR 1.45）。你可以更有信心地考虑为符合条件的、处于延长时间窗的患者推荐 IVT 治疗。
items.titleZh: 急性缺血性卒中延长时间窗溶栓（4.5-24 小时）：一项随机对照试验的系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 8 项急性缺血性卒中延长时间窗静脉溶栓（4.5-24 小时）随机对照试验（n=2548）的荟萃分析发现，静脉溶栓显著增加了 90 天改良 Rankin 量表 0-1 分的几率（OR 1.45, 95% CI 1.23-1.72）。它也增加了早期神经功能改善（OR 1.59），但对 90 天改良 Rankin 量表 0-2 分无显著改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This meta-analysis of 8 RCTs, involving 2548 patients, clearly indicates that intravenous thrombolysis (IVT) administered 4.5 to 24 hours after acute ischemic stroke onset significantly increases the odds of excellent functional outcome (mRS 0-1) at 90 days (OR 1.45). You can recommend IVT with more confidence for eligible patients within the extended time window.
items.limitation: 荟萃分析主要基于汇总数据，且纳入试验中大部分使用了组织不匹配影像学筛选患者，可能限制结果对所有卒中患者的普适性。
items.limitationEn: The meta-analysis primarily used aggregate data, and most included trials used tissue mismatch imaging for patient selection, which may limit the generalizability of results to all stroke patients.

items.title: Impact of Rehabilitation Initiation Timing on Safety and Efficacy in Patients With Acute Stroke and Concurrent Heart Failure.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study (n=9827) found very early rehabilitation (admission day or day 1) for acute stroke patients with heart failure was not associated with increased major adverse events. It was linked to a lower risk of in-hospital respiratory failure (RR=0.58) and 90-day stroke readmission (RR=0.33), and a higher discharge Barthel Index (mean difference=3.66) compared to delayed rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 卒中合并心力衰竭患者通常康复启动较晚。这项观察性研究表明，极早期康复（住院当日或次日）不仅安全，且与更好的巴氏指数和更低的再入院风险相关，提示我们应更积极地评估患者的早期康复潜力。
items.titleZh: 卒中合并心力衰竭患者康复启动时机对安全性和疗效的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究（n=9827）发现，对于急性卒中合并心力衰竭的患者，极早期康复（入院当日或次日）并未增加主要不良事件风险。与延迟康复相比，极早期康复与院内呼吸衰竭（RR=0.58）和 90 天卒中再入院（RR=0.33）风险降低，以及出院时巴氏指数（平均差=3.66）提高有关。
items.curatedReasonEn: Rehabilitation for stroke patients with heart failure is often delayed. This observational study indicates that very early rehabilitation (on admission day or day 1) is safe and associated with better Barthel Index scores and lower readmission risk, suggesting a more proactive approach to early rehabilitation potential.
items.limitation: 作为一项回顾性观察研究，无法证明因果关系，且可能存在未调整的混杂因素，如患者的疾病严重程度和康复强度信息不足。
items.limitationEn: As a retrospective observational study, it cannot prove causality and may have unadjusted confounders, such as insufficient information on patient severity and rehabilitation intensity.

items.title: Manual techniques for headache: who delivers what and where? A systematic review of randomized controlled trials with a practice-mapping analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review of 35 RCTs on manual techniques for headache found high-velocity, low-amplitude spinal manipulation was predominant (60%), mainly for tension-type (40%) and cervicogenic (29%) headaches. Practice mapping showed no association between technique and headache type (p=0.453) but significant associations with professional background (V=0.54, p=0.044), departmental setting (V=0.77, p=0.0012), and geographic localization (V=0.853, p<0.001).
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述强调，头痛的手法治疗实践受限于治疗师背景、机构设置和地理区域，而非基于标准化诊断。这提示你，目前手法治疗在头痛管理中的应用还缺乏统一的循证指导，需要更多高质量研究。
items.titleZh: 头痛的手法技术：谁在何处提供何种服务？一项带有实践映射分析的随机对照试验系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 35 项头痛手法技术随机对照试验的系统综述发现，高速低幅脊柱推拿是主要技术（60%），主要用于紧张性头痛（40%）和颈源性头痛（29%）。实践映射分析显示，技术与头痛类型无关联（p=0.453），但与专业背景（V=0.54, p=0.044）、科室设置（V=0.77, p=0.0012）和地理位置（V=0.853, p<0.001）显著相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review highlights that manual therapy practice for headaches is shaped by practitioner background, institutional setting, and geographic context, rather than standardized diagnosis. This suggests that current manual therapy application in headache management lacks uniform evidence-based guidance, necessitating more high-quality research.
items.limitation: 纳入的 35 项 RCT 在方法学和报告标准上可能存在异质性，影响了实践映射分析的深度。
items.limitationEn: The 35 included RCTs may have methodological and reporting heterogeneities, affecting the depth of practice-mapping analysis.
